resources.string: Helps recognize WeChat transfers, red packets and incoming Alipay transfers when notifications do not contain an amount. The service is limited to WeChat and Alipay and does not inspect other apps. Transactions are stored on the phone unless you explicitly enable sync.

Optional extra capture: reads supported WeChat/Alipay payment-success pages, takes a local screenshot after safety checks and creates a candidate for review. It does not scroll, import history or upload screenshots. Turning it off does not affect notification, SMS or manual bookkeeping.
